_language_discipline: A search result is not a cohort and a cohort is not a result. Nothing here is an efficacy, selectivity, safety or clinical-readiness claim, and no expression value is computed in this module.
_what: Is there a FOURTH EMC expression cohort anyone could read?
_what_a_negative_bounds: GEO esearch matches DEPOSITOR PROSE. A series whose title and summary never name EMC is invisible to every query here however many EMC samples it holds. A null result bounds what a term search over GEO can reach; it is NOT a statement that no fourth cohort exists.

positive_control._note: each is recovered and then EXCLUDED by the dedup, which is the intended path: recovery proves the queries reach EMC deposits, exclusion proves the guard recognises the ones already used
positive_control._why: a null result from an instrument that recovers no known positive is not a negative, it is a broken search

queries.why: the disease name in full, the highest-precision term
the shortened name, restricted to expression series
the fusion rather than the disease — catches a deposit indexed by its driver

queries.term: NR4A3[All Fields] AND sarcoma[All Fields] AND "expression profiling"[Filter]
queries.why: the 3' partner plus lineage, for a pan-sarcoma deposit that names NR4A3 but not EMC
deliberately over-broad: EMC samples inside a general chondrosarcoma series

queries.term: sarcoma[All Fields] AND "translocation"[All Fields] AND "expression profiling"[Filter]
queries.why: translocation-sarcoma panels, the kind of deposit EMC hides inside

query_summary._why_every_query_is_recorded: a query that returns nothing is indistinguishable from a dataset that does not exist unless the query itself is on the record

verdict.headline: No fourth EMC expression cohort was found. Every series any query returned is either already used by the manuscript, shares a publication or samples with one, is not a series at all, or carries too few EMC samples to contrast.
verdict.⛔ scope: GEO esearch matches DEPOSITOR PROSE. A series whose title and summary never name EMC is invisible to every query here however many EMC samples it holds. A null result bounds what a term search over GEO can reach; it is NOT a statement that no fourth cohort exists.
